applies_why: The judge text gives a DEFENDER WINS/HELD result, so this rule governs whether that result is allowed.
quote: CHALLENGE STANDING: PROP-DEPENDENT -- L=6 c=0 -- The challenger cannot be self-supported because link C3 was broken at collision against explicit conception bounds.
rule_words: HELD gives DEFENDER WINS only if CHALLENGE STANDING is not SELF-SUPPORTED or at least one collision is graded CHALLENGER LINK BROKEN.
room: The phrase 'CHALLENGE STANDING is not SELF-SUPPORTED or at least one collision is graded CHALLENGER LINK BROKEN': I weighed whether the retracted BROKEN grade removes the only basis versus whether the separate standing line still satisfies the rule; the text states the standing is not self-supported.
why: The judge's text expressly states CHALLENGE STANDING is not self-supported, so the rule's necessary condition is met even though the collision grade was retracted.
